## Findings
- [ ] **[WARN][Tests] CLI exec tests hang locally; local full-tier run cannot cover `cmd/symdesk`**
  - **Status quo:** `cmd/symdesk` tests block until the Go test timeout on this machine (blocked `database/sql.OpenDB`); three `internal/service` tests also fail locally. Both reproduce on unmodified `main` and at `v0.6.11`, while CI on the exact HEAD SHA is green on ubuntu and macos.
  - **Likely cause:** Local-environment difference (Go 1.26.5 vs CI 1.26.4, or machine state); exec tests open the sidecar DB without a fail-fast timeout.
  - **Proposed solution:** Fix test isolation/fail-fast DB open so the package completes locally (already filed as a follow-up task; also captured as a Tests/Design finding in the coverage report).
  - **Handoff:** `/02-gh-plan --from-coverage .github/coverage/2026-07-13T16-52-23Z.md` → `/03-gh-go`
